title: Get task run
description: Get full details for a specific task run including status, stage, environment, branch, artifacts summary, state, error message, and timestamps. Sandbox connection credentials (`state.sandbox_connect_token`, `state.sandbox_url`) and the presigned `log_url` are omitted from the response.

methodDocumentation.text: Retrieve a single run for a specific task.

Get full details for a specific task run including status, stage, environment, branch, artifacts summary, state, error message, and timestamps. Sandbox connection credentials (`state.sandbox_connect_token`, `state.sandbox_url`) and the presigned `log_url` are omitted from the response.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription:
Detail response for a task run.

Reads from a frozen ``TaskRunDetailDTO`` produced by the facade mapper (which computes the
presigned ``log_url`` and parses ``runtime_adapter`` / ``provider`` / ``model`` /
``reasoning_effort`` off the run state). ``task`` is the parent task id. Reused as the nested
``latest_run`` shape by the task detail response.
